comments.author: participant5
comments.body:
> For everyone not following all the upstream threads, there was an issue found in one of the upstream libraries, there is a fix in place that will make its way down the stack soon.

Could you please provide more details or references about the issue and fix? Thanks!

comments.author: participant6
comments.body:
> Could you please provide more details or references about the issue and fix? Thanks!

This is what I understand after a quick look: `curl` uses `c-ares` which had [this issue](https://github.com/c-ares/c-ares/pull/661) that came about because the host OS kernel was an earlier version than `curl` was compiled on. The earlier host kernel did not have a function that the library expected it to have which caused the process to hang.
